title: A generic 2D vector
hints: Operators in a generic type are written like any others: `public static Vec2<T> operator +(Vec2<T> a, Vec2<T> b) => new(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y);`, and `+` on `T` works because of the `INumber<T>` constraint (lesson 8.03).
`TOther.CreateChecked(X)` converts one number type to another and throws when it does not fit.
lessonTitle: Generic Math and Static Abstract Members
